answer: An adversary thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The quartz counter is kept in cipher and trellis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1624 identities would post 931 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
